Events Calendar | Asheville Downtown Association | The Voice of Downtownhttps://www.ashevilledowntown.org/events/Fri, 02 Oct 2026 16:12:05 +0000en-USSite-Server redacted@example.invalid@ (http://www.squarespace.com)Downtown Diamond Dash 5kFri, 28 Aug 2026 13:57:01 +0000https://www.ashevilledowntown.org/events/downtown-diamond-dash-5k66425c06b44bfb10f0fc1395:6643747feef91b48d6c4d6fc:6a919284b08c05004566a7e1Get ready to lace up your running shoes and make history at the Downtown Diamond Dash 5K, Asheville’s newest and most exciting road race! This inaugural event begins at HomeTrust Park, home of the Asheville Tourists, and takes runners on a scenic and energizing route through the heart of downtown Asheville before finishing in unforgettable fashion—on the baseball field’s warning track.

Race day kicks off with check-in opening at 7:00 AM (day before packet pick up to be announced), giving participants time to soak in the ballpark atmosphere and prepare for the 8:00 AM start. From the first step out of the stadium, runners will experience a dynamic course that blends the charm of Asheville’s vibrant streets with the thrill of a stadium finish.

As an official USA Track & Field certified course, runners can trust the accuracy of the 5K distance, ensuring every mile marker counts toward personal bests and race goals. USA Track & Field certification means the course has been precisely measured to meet national standards. Professional chip timing will be provided by Right on Time Productions, delivering accurate results and a seamless race-day experience.

Whether you’re chasing a PR, enjoying a fun run with friends, or simply looking to be part of something new, the Downtown Diamond Dash 5K offers a one-of-a-kind experience. Cross the finish line where the pros play, celebrate your accomplishment on the field-level, and be part of the very first chapter of what promises to become a beloved Asheville tradition.

Join us for a race that hits it out of the park—see you at the starting line!

Asheville Museum of Science 43 Patton Ave

Tickets here

This Halloween season are you ready to step into the world of conspiracy theories, local lore, and urban legends?

Join our community of science experts, storytellers, artists, and folklorists as we bunk or debunk some of history’s greatest mysteries. 

 Many activities, experiments, demonstrations, and specialty cocktails at After Hours abound this spooky season.

Costumes are encouraged but cannot include masks that cover the entire face, weapons, or weapon-like objects. 

Pre-registration is strongly recommended. Tickets are $25 online*. 

Must be 21+, your admission includes one free drink.

]]>Member Mixer - Reflecting & Looking Ahead Asheville Holiday ParadeWed, 07 Jan 2026 18:46:23 +0000https://www.ashevilledowntown.org/events/asheville-holiday-parade-wkskc66425c06b44bfb10f0fc1395:6643747feef91b48d6c4d6fc:695ea99e4430c23b6667ef87The Holiday Parade Returns!

Downtown Asheville’s beloved Holiday Parade is returning to the heart of downtown for a festive celebration of the season. This annual tradition brings together community groups, schools, nonprofits, local organizations, and spectators of all ages for a joyful parade filled with creativity, music, and holiday cheer.

Parade entries will be invited to showcase their holiday spirit through decorated floats, vehicles, costumes, and performances. Volunteer support will once again play a vital role in bringing the parade to life, with opportunities for community groups and nonprofits to get involved.

Additional details—including the parade route, schedule, registration information, and volunteer opportunities—will be announced closer to the event.

Let’s come together downtown to celebrate the season and continue this cherished holiday tradition. 🎅🎶🎄
